get_involved_description: Izinsiza zethu zamahhala zenza kube lula ukusabalalisa ukwamukelwa kwe-Bitcoin. Izitika, amaphephandaba, izitika ezithi 'I-Bitcoin Yamukelwa Lapha' zamabhizinisi, nekhodi evulekile noma ubani angafaka isandla kuyo.
get_involved_intro_1: Kungadabukisa ukuphila esimweni samanje somhlaba wethu.
get_involved_intro_2: Imali yethu iphukile. Ngenxa yalokho, izingxenye eziyisisekelo zomphakathi nazo ziphukile.
get_involved_intro_3: Uma usuvele usebenzisa i-Bitcoin, uyayazi imizwa yethemba i-Bitcoin engayiletha. Ithemba lekusasa eliqhakazile elenzeka ngemali engcono.
get_involved_intro_4: Kodwa abantu abaningi abakuzungezile abazi nge-Bitcoin. Bahlala emhlabeni ophukile njengawe, kodwa ngaphandle kwekhanyiso lethemba lokubisiza ebumnyameni.
get_involved_intro_5: Ungasiza ukushintsha lokho. Senze izinsiza zamahhala eziningi ukwenza kube lula ukusabalalisa ithemba elilethwa yi-Bitcoin kulabo abakuzungezile.
get_involved_sticker_image_alt: Iphakethe lezitika zombhalo we-Bitcoin lamahhala elivela ku-bitcoin.rocks
get_involved_sticker_content_1: Ungasiza ukufundisa abakuzungezile nge-Bitcoin ngaphandle kokudinga ukuhlangana naye. Beka nje esinye sezitika zethu ze-Bitcoin zamahhala emphakathini.
get_involved_sticker_content_2: Amakhulu abantu askena amakhodi e-QR kule zitika nyanga zonke. Izitika zenfleshini zixhumana nekhasi nge
get_involved_sticker_content_4: Izinye izitika zixhumana nekhasi lethu lemfundo lasekhaya elibonisa abantu indlela
get_involved_sticker_content_6: Ngokubeka lezi zitika emphakathini wakho ezindaweni abantu abazozibona, ungasiza abakuzungezile bathathe izinyathelo zabo zokuqala emgodini we-Bitcoin.
get_involved_card_stickers_title: Cela iphakethe lezitika ze-Bitcoin lamahhala lithunyelwe emnyango wakho
get_involved_flyers_image_alt: Ukubuka kweqephandaba le-Bitcoin lamahhala eliphrintekayo elivela ku-bitcoin.rocks
get_involved_flyers_content_1: Amaphephandaba ayingenye yezindlela ezilula zokwethula i-Bitcoin emphakathini wakho. Landa iphephandaba le-Bitcoin elimahlala eliphrintekayo, uphrinte amakhophi amaningi ngokuthanda, futhi uwafake emabhodini omphakathi, ezindaweni zekhofi, emihlanganweni, noma kunoma kuphi lapho abantu behlangana khona.
get_involved_flyers_content_2: Iphephandaba ngalinye lifaka ihedi elidonsayo nekhodi le-QR ethumela abafundi abafuna ukwazi ku-bitcoin.rocks ukuze bafunde okwengeziwe.
get_involved_flyers_content_3: Ngokungafani nezitika, amaphephandaba angaphrintwa ngokufuna kunoma kuphi emhlabeni — okudingayo nje yiprinta nemizuzu embalwa.
get_involved_card_flyers_title: Landa futhi uphrinte iphephandaba le-Bitcoin lamahhala
get_involved_business_content_1: Ufuna ukusiza ukwakha umnotho ozungeza we-Bitcoin? Indlela elula yikusiza amabhizinisi endawo aqale ukwamukela izinkokhelo ze-Bitcoin.
get_involved_business_content_2: Wazi ibhizinisi elingaba lulungele lokho? Thumela umnikazi ku
get_involved_card_business_title: Konke ibhizinisi elidinga ukuze liqale ukwamukela izinkokhelo ze-Bitcoin
get_involved_biz_stickers_note: Usuvele wamukela i-Bitcoin? Yenza amakhasimende akwazi ngezitika zethu zamahhala 'I-Bitcoin Yamukelwa Lapha'. Sizothumela iphakethe kunoma yiliphi ikheli e-USA noma e-Canada, noma ungaphrinta esakho kunoma kuphi emhlabeni.
get_involved_card_biz_stickers_title: Izitika zamahhala 'I-Bitcoin Yamukelwa Lapha' zebhizinisi lakho
get_involved_github_content_1: i-bitcoin.rocks iyiphrojekthi yamahhala, evulekile, esebenza ngaphansi kwe-MIT License. Umsebenzi wethu uwukusheshisa ukwamukelwa kwe-Bitcoin ngemfundo — futhi asikwazi ukukwenza sodwa.
get_involved_github_content_2: Noma ngabe ungumthuthukisi, umdwebi, umlobi, noma umhumushi, kukhona indlela ongasiza ngayo. Samukela ikakhulukazi abafaki isandla abangahumusha okuqukethwe kwethu kuzilimi eziningi ukuze abantu abaningi emhlabeni bafunde nge-Bitcoin ngolimi lwabo lwemvelo.
get_involved_github_content_3: Yenza i-fork yendawo yokugcina ikhodi, vula i-pull request, faka isikhalo, noma ufaka inkanyezi ephrojekthini ukukhombisa ukwesekela kwakho. Wonke umnikelo usiza i-Bitcoin ifinyelele abantu abaningi.
